resolvedSemantics.objective: Minimize the maximum edge weight along a path in an undirected weighted graph, exactly as stated in the source.
resolvedSemantics.nodeIndexing: The sample uses nodes 1..N and each of the three source implementations allocates arrays of size N+1; candidate uses 1-based IDs.
resolvedSemantics.sourceDestinationEqual: All three source implementations initialize dist[source]=0 and return that value immediately when source is destination; candidate makes this explicit.
resolvedSemantics.siteConstraints: The original Constraints contains only a damaged placeholder. Candidate adds N<=5000, M<=20000, 1<=node IDs<=N, and 0<=w<=1e9. Nonnegative weights define the site-supported domain; graph connectivity is not assumed.
